isolation_rule: No records, performance results, or policy decisions may cross-contaminate objectives. Each objective keeps its own frozen artifacts; the router tags every node with its objective_lane.

OBJECTIVE_A_FOLLOWER.definition: mirror Farouk's published follower method as-is
OBJECTIVE_A_FOLLOWER.router_may: annotate context around published zone; MUST NOT modify follower entries

OBJECTIVE_B_ENHANCED_FOLLOWER.definition: keep Farouk's published DIRECTION + ZONE, but study optional refined entries
OBJECTIVE_B_ENHANCED_FOLLOWER.router_may: enumerate refined-entry candidates as SHADOW; MUST NOT select one or route it

OBJECTIVE_C_INDEPENDENT.definition: Orange derives regime/liquidity/POI/confirmation/entry WITHOUT relying on Farouk's published zone
OBJECTIVE_C_INDEPENDENT.inputs: causal market features only (no published zone as an input to selection)
OBJECTIVE_C_INDEPENDENT.router_may: produce a blind independent hypothesis (already wired via hypothesis_generator); MUST NOT create live proposals

cross_contamination_guards: objective_lane stamped on every router node
OBJECTIVE_C hypothesis cannot read Farouk's published zone selection as a feature
no shared performance ledger across objectives
no objective may promote another's candidate
